title: 企业知识助手 · 连接配置
description: 访问令牌仅用于连接你所在企业已授权的知识库与业务数据，凭证仅保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录，不会上传云端。
description_en: The access token is only used to connect to your organization's authorized knowledge base and business data. Credentials are stored locally in ~/.workbuddy and never uploaded.
